english.title: Speeding - exceed 5 / 18 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 mph limit for a goods vehicle - unmanned automatic equipment
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a mechanically propelled vehicle, being a

(A)_[vehicle,]_
(B)_[vehicle and trailer.]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a

(C)_[single carriageway road,]_
(D)_[dual carriageway road,]_
(E)_[motorway,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE ROAD / MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..), at a speed exceeding

(F)_[5]_
(G)_[18]_
(H)_[20]_
(I)_[30]_
(J)_[40]_
(K)_[50]_
(L)_[60]_

miles per hour, the speed specified in Schedule 6 to the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 as being the maximum speed in relation to a vehicle of that class
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 86(1) and 89(1) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
drive a goods vehicle on a road
at a speed exceeding 5/18/20/30/40/50/60 mph
being the maximum speed for a vehicle of that class

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Schedule 6 referred to in the wording of the offence wording is several pages long and is not reproduced in the database. Please refer to the paper document if there is any doubt about the exact wording in relation to a particular class of vehicle.
(ii) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wording: H4694 - relating to manned equipment.
(iv) Fixed penalty ticket scheme may be applied
